title: The Sweet Vow
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Juniper Oyelaran, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
